test.title: Section 1 · children’s parties and an ice rink

texts.label: A
texts.title: Children’s parties — four venues in Hadley

paragraphs.text: Splash Zone at Hadley Pool. Party packages for up to twenty children aged five and over include an hour in the small pool, with an inflatable obstacle course, followed by forty minutes in the party room. Food is provided by the pool café, and a lifeguard stays with the group from start to finish. Weekend parties must be booked at least four weeks ahead.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Rolling Hills Farm. Children help to feed the lambs and goats, take a ride on a tractor trailer and finish with a picnic in the barn. You are welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake, but please tell us in advance about any allergies so that animal feed can be kept away from the picnic area. Farm parties run from April to October only.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Brightside Craft Studio. An artist shows the children how to make a clay model or paint a small canvas. Models are fired in the kiln and paintings are varnished, so the finished work is ready to collect a week after the party. Groups are limited to twelve, which makes this a good choice for younger children or a quieter celebration. We do not provide party food, but we are happy to recommend a local caterer.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Jumpworks Trampoline Park. Parties last ninety minutes and can be booked seven days a week, including evenings. A coach leads warm-up games before free jumping, and the group then has its own table in the café. Every child needs a form signed by a parent or carer before they are allowed on the trampolines, and non-slip socks, which the children keep afterwards, are included in the price.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Kestrel Ice Rink — public skating. Public sessions last two hours and start at 10 am, 1 pm and 4 pm every day. On Fridays and Saturdays there is an extra session from 7.30 pm to 9.30 pm, when music is played and the lights are turned down. The rink is closed to the public on Tuesday mornings for ice hockey training and occasionally at other times for competitions; these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Admission is £8 for adults and £6 for children under fourteen, including the hire of skates. Skaters who bring their own skates pay £1.50 less. Everyone on the ice must wear gloves, and helmets are strongly recommended for children. Both can be bought at the reception desk, and helmets may also be borrowed free of charge. Children under eight must be accompanied on the ice by a paying adult.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Beginners may use plastic skating frames, which help them to keep their balance. There is a small stock by the rink entrance; frames cannot be reserved and are handed out in the order that people arrive. Food and drink may not be taken onto the ice. Lockers are provided in the changing area, and lost property is kept for one month. Group lessons for beginners take place on Sunday mornings before the first public session; places are limited and must be booked online.
paragraphs.label: C

document.title: Section 1 · children’s parties and an ice rink

topic.en: Two everyday texts: four venues for a children’s party and the rules of an ice rink.
topic.kk: Екі тұрмыстық мәтін: балалар мерекесіне арналған төрт орын және мұз айдынының ережелері.
topic.ru: Два бытовых текста: четыре площадки для детского праздника и правила катка.

items.quote: the finished work is ready to collect a week after the party
items.prompt: Children’s work is not ready to take away on the day of the party.

explanation.en: “the finished work is ready to collect a week after the party” → C. In D the children also keep something (socks), but on the day, and they did not make it.
explanation.kk: «the finished work is ready to collect a week after the party» → C. D-да да балалар шұлықты алып кетеді, бірақ сол күні, әрі оны өздері жасамаған.
explanation.ru: «the finished work is ready to collect a week after the party» → C. В D дети тоже что-то уносят (носки), но в тот же день, и сделали их не они.

items.quote: Farm parties run from April to October only
items.prompt: Parties at this venue are not available all year round.

explanation.en: “Farm parties run from April to October only” → B: there are no farm parties from November to March.
explanation.kk: «Farm parties run from April to October only» → B: қарашадан наурызға дейін фермада мереке өтпейді.
explanation.ru: «Farm parties run from April to October only» → B: с ноября по март праздников на ферме нет.

items.quote: You are welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake
items.prompt: Families may bring their own refreshments.

explanation.en: “You are welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake” → B. C gives no food either, but it suggests a caterer, not your own food.
explanation.kk: «You are welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake» → B. C-да да тамақ берілмейді, бірақ онда өз тамағыңызды емес, кейтерингті ұсынады.
explanation.ru: «You are welcome to bring your own food and birthday cake» → B. В C еды тоже нет, но там советуют кейтеринг, а не свою еду.

items.quote: a lifeguard stays with the group from start to finish
items.prompt: A member of staff watches over the children’s safety throughout.

explanation.en: “a lifeguard stays with the group from start to finish” → A. The coach in D only leads the warm-up games.
explanation.kk: «a lifeguard stays with the group from start to finish» → A: құтқарушы басынан аяғына дейін қасында. D-дағы бапкер тек алғашқы ойындарды жүргізеді.
explanation.ru: «a lifeguard stays with the group from start to finish» → A: спасатель рядом всё время. Тренер в D ведёт только разминку.

items.quote: Every child needs a form signed by a parent or carer
items.prompt: An adult has to give written permission for each child.

explanation.en: “Every child needs a form signed by a parent or carer” → D: written consent from an adult for every child.
explanation.kk: «Every child needs a form signed by a parent or carer» → D: әр балаға ересектің жазбаша келісімі керек.
explanation.ru: «Every child needs a form signed by a parent or carer» → D: письменное согласие взрослого на каждого ребёнка.

groups.instruction: Text A describes four party venues, A–D. Which venue does each statement refer to? Write the correct letter, A–D. You may use any letter more than once.

items.quote: there is an extra session from 7.30 pm to 9.30 pm
items.prompt: The Friday evening session is longer than the daytime sessions.

explanation.en: The evening session, 7.30–9.30, is two hours, and the day sessions also “last two hours” → FALSE: they are the same length.
explanation.kk: Кешкі сеанс 7.30–9.30 — екі сағат, күндізгі сеанстар да «last two hours» → FALSE: ұзақтығы бірдей.
explanation.ru: Вечерний сеанс 7.30–9.30 — два часа, и дневные тоже «last two hours» → FALSE: длина одинаковая.

items.quote: these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance
items.prompt: Skaters are warned about competition closures some days beforehand.

explanation.en: “these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance” → TRUE: closures are announced beforehand.
explanation.kk: «these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance» → TRUE: жабылатыны алдын ала хабарланады.
explanation.ru: «these closures are shown on our website at least a week in advance» → TRUE: о закрытии сообщают заранее.

items.quote: helmets may also be borrowed free of charge
items.prompt: The only way to get a helmet is to buy one at reception.

explanation.en: “helmets may also be borrowed free of charge” → FALSE: a helmet can be bought or borrowed for free.
explanation.kk: «helmets may also be borrowed free of charge» → FALSE: дулығаны сатып алуға да, тегін алып тұруға да болады.
explanation.ru: «helmets may also be borrowed free of charge» → FALSE: шлем можно и купить, и взять бесплатно.

items.quote: Both can be bought at the reception desk
items.prompt: Hot drinks are on sale at the reception desk.

explanation.en: Gloves and helmets are sold at reception (“Both can be bought at the reception desk”); drinks are never mentioned → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Ресепшенде қолғап пен дулыға сатылады («Both can be bought at the reception desk»); сусын туралы ештеңе айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: На ресепшене продают перчатки и шлемы («Both can be bought at the reception desk»); о напитках ничего не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: lost property is kept for one month
items.prompt: Items left behind are given to charity after a month.

explanation.en: “lost property is kept for one month” — we learn how long, not what happens afterwards → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: «lost property is kept for one month» — заттың қанша сақталатыны айтылған; кейін не болатыны айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: «lost property is kept for one month» — сказано, сколько хранят вещи; что с ними потом, не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information given in Text B? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

items.quote: Everyone on the ice must wear gloves
items.prompt: What is compulsory for all skaters, whatever their age?

explanation.en: “Everyone on the ice must wear gloves” → gloves. Helmets are only “strongly recommended”, and only for children.
explanation.kk: «Everyone on the ice must wear gloves» → gloves. Дулыға тек «strongly recommended», әрі тек балаларға.
explanation.ru: «Everyone on the ice must wear gloves» → gloves. Шлемы только «strongly recommended», и только детям.

items.quote: Children under eight must be accompanied on the ice by a paying adult
items.prompt: Who has to go on the ice with skaters aged seven or younger?

explanation.en: “Children under eight must be accompanied on the ice by a paying adult” → a paying adult. “Seven or younger” means the same as “under eight”.
explanation.kk: «Children under eight must be accompanied on the ice by a paying adult» → a paying adult. «Seven or younger» мен «under eight» — бір мағына.
explanation.ru: «Children under eight must be accompanied on the ice by a paying adult» → a paying adult. «Seven or younger» — то же, что «under eight».

items.quote: Group lessons for beginners take place on Sunday mornings
items.prompt: When do the classes for new skaters take place?

explanation.en: “Group lessons for beginners take place on Sunday mornings” → Sunday mornings. Tuesday mornings are when the rink closes for hockey.
explanation.kk: «Group lessons for beginners take place on Sunday mornings» → Sunday mornings. Сейсенбі таңы — хоккей үшін жабылатын уақыт.
explanation.ru: «Group lessons for beginners take place on Sunday mornings» → Sunday mornings. Утро вторника — это закрытие катка на хоккей.
